unicode/normalization#

Immutable Unicode 18.0.0 normalization.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

string Normalized(origin: "é", form: NormalizationForm.nfc);
// "é"

Normalized(origin: "ﬃ", form: NormalizationForm.nfkc).string();
// "ffi"

Description#

Immutable Unicode 18.0.0 normalization.

NFC and NFD perform canonical composition and decomposition. NFKC and NFKD additionally apply compatibility mappings:

Normalization never trims, case-folds or otherwise rewrites text beyond the selected Unicode normalization algorithm. The source string remains unchanged and normalizing an already normalized result is idempotent. The normalization data is newer than the character properties of unicode/character (Unicode 17.0.0): a character added since is decomposed and reordered by its own data here, yet unassigned there.
